decision: Static equation/support/gradient-boundary review PASS; numerical and memory qualification outstanding. Suitable for an independently guarded paired diagnostic, not a validated production adoption.
findings: Resident _second retains all original clade, episode and stable-leaf-memory injection equations, same first-upward input, same base/edge gates and original second sweep. Only the final leaf-context .to(cpu) is removed.

Inherited context_forward preserves CPU first upward/outside states, forcing and complete bidirectional history; checkpoint preserve_rng_state=True remains intact. Context blocks concatenate in the original native order.

Decoder retains original full genomic sequence per haplotype tile, forward and reverse scan, exact focal row selection, summed CE divided by the complete original focal count, and one zero-initialized complete context VJP. Empty focal tiles remain zero-gradient and do not omit upstream observed contributions.

Detaching the resident tile at the same boundary prevents decoder backward from prematurely traversing the trunk. Returning its CUDA VJP and calling context.backward(VJP) reconnects exactly once. Device-local copy_ into VJP changes storage placement, not differentiation.
Even when contiguous() returns an alias, tile detach creates a new leaf and neither decoder path mutates context values. Current source therefore has no alias write hazard.
No data/labels/simulation/reference order/coverage/history boundary is changed. Mathematical equivalence remains subject to FP32 execution/accumulation order and measured gradients/optimizer states.

memory_gate.notation: C = 4 * native_holds *1600*32 bytes for one FP32 complete context.
memory_gate.known_live_arrays: At final context concatenation, all block outputs and the concatenated context can overlap (~2C). During decoder, complete context plus complete VJP cost ~2C, plus contiguous tile copy, both recurrent directions, checkpoint saves, model/optimizer buffers and allocator reservation. Trunk backward may add further scratch.
memory_gate.not_proven: A64GiB profile budget is not a proven full-parent peak. CPU staged states remain large. Reset allocator peaks and measure every arm; process-lifetime max RSS is cumulative.
requirements: Static pre-admission with actual parent T, original block/tile settings and bounded scratch estimate.
Guard own session only; do not evict unrelated work or silently reduce input support on OOM.
Compare logits, loss, gradients, clipped norm, parameters, Adam moments and exact step counts against same restored checkpoint/RNG arm.
Keep original full genomic boundaries and match all focal IDs; record argmax mismatches and margin.
